We need number of CH3 groups in the compound. But we don't have the compound given. Possibly need to retrieve NMR spectra to infer? But we don't know which compound. Maybe the system expects we ask for NMR? However the task likely expects we have a molecule from previous context? No context provided. Could be that the compound is the sample at hand, which the tools can measure NMR for. We could get proton NMR and count methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed). It will return a string with peaks. Then we can count number of methyl groups (triplet around 0.9 ppm etc). But ambiguous. Maybe easier: use carbon_nmr_spectra to see number of methyl carbons (around 10-30 ppm). Count distinct signals.

We need to minimize cost. Probably just get carbon NMR. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
